clips.title: The story
paras: At Sentinel Hill in Westfall, Gryan Stoutmantle leads the People's Militia. A paladin of the Silver Hand, he returned from Lordaeron to defend his birthplace after Stormwind's crown left it to banditry.

Gryan Stoutmantle first served far from Westfall's fields. As a young man, he traveled north to Lordaeron and took vows as a Knight of the Silver Hand. He endured the horrors of the Third War there. News reached him that his native province was collapsing into lawlessness, overrun by organized brigands and abandoned by the crown. Gryan left the northern fronts to defend honest farmers, determined that his home would not fall as the north had.

When Gryan returned, Westfall had virtually no defenders. Royal neglect and political paralysis in the House of Nobles kept Stormwind from sending garrison troops. Gryan formed the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill, gathering local farmers, sentries, and traveling mercenaries into a volunteer defense corps. The militia holds a precarious line against the Defias Brotherhood, riverpaw gnolls, and hostile mechanoids. Even when nearby Lakeshire pleads for aid, Gryan cannot spare reinforcements.
